dedupe_keys.name: data for limitations to air free cooling in data centers under rising heat and humidity

description: This deposit supplies processed NetCDF arrays for the main and supplementary figures of a study on air-side free cooling in data centres under rising heat and humidity. Zenodo lists nine public files under CC BY 4.0. The provider says the figures derive from hourly reanalysis for 1980–2024 and CMIP6 projections, with seasonal and sensitivity analyses. These arrays can provide climate exposure inputs or benchmarks for cooling-demand and water-use scenarios, provided a modeller reconstructs each figure variable and units. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these processed study outputs. A limitation is that the files are figure data, not observed operating records from a data-centre fleet and not a complete raw climate archive. The record description contains an unresolved placeholder for a dataset DOI; the actual Zenodo DOI is taken from its API. The associated article status and precise NetCDF variable schemas were not independently verified. No NetCDF file was downloaded or recomputed.
